vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species dictyostelium_discoideum --assembly dicty_2.7 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (6, CH709148 and CH709182) at their full length from Dictyostelium_discoideum.dicty_2.7.dna.chromosome.6.fa.gz and Dictyostelium_discoideum.dicty_2.7.dna.nonchromosomal.fa.gz of Ensembl Genomes release 63 (Ensembl Protists), each file held to the sum of the directory's CHECKSUMS; every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 283 records on chromosome 6 (223 records) and the unplaced sequences CH709148 (29) and CH709182 (31); 24 of them name their sequence by a synonym the cache's chr_synonyms.txt lists (CM000155.2, CH709148.1, CH709182.1). All come from tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 2, seed 1, --records wide --per-category 36, one --sequence for each of the three sequences, every reference allele read from the genome file), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal: 23 categories, among them start and stop codons under the standard genetic code, a missense and a synonymous change on each strand, both splice sites, a 5' untranslated region, an intron, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion, an in-frame deletion and the first and the last base of a sequence. The cache holds no known variant, no transcript with a 3' untranslated region, no circular sequence and no genetic code but the standard one, so the corpus has no record of those kinds; no record is multi-allelic

generator: Ensembl VEP over the record pool under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly dicty_2.7 --species dictyostelium_discoideum --dataset wide=<reference>=<the generated records> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <the named records> --covers species-dictyostelium-dicty2 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl Protists release 63 dicty_2.7 cache (the cache carries no variation files, no SIFT or PolyPhen predictions and no regulatory data); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <the three sequences> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, run over the records with each sequence synonym written as the cache's name; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp for the hgvs set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: none: the cache holds no variation file
